rv.q: Affectionate and imaginative adaptation of the much-loved comic strip from musical theatre duo Scott Gilmour and Claire McKenzie

Oor Wullie achieves all it must, and more, within the opening moments. The rest is just pure dead brilliant. The entire audience, Dundonian or from further afield, feel at home the moment the opening number brings us into hurtling into Dundee city centre, a stop-over in Auchenshoogle on the cards.

This Oor Wullie is a more polished affair than its predecessor, and more tightly plotted. The opening number, 'I'm Going Home' is a big, cheery, uplifting affair well suited to passengers embarking from King's Cross on a train bound for distant Dundee.
